scene.label: Act 2, Scene 1
scene.title: SCENE I. Belmont. A room in Portia's house.
scene.location: Belmont. A room in Portia's house.

content.text: Flourish of cornets. Enter the Prince of Morocco, a tawny Moor all in white, and three or four followers accordingly, with Portia, Nerissa and their train.

lines.text: Mislike me not for my complexion,
lines.plainText: Mislike me not for my complexion

lines.text: The shadowed livery of the burnish'd sun,
lines.plainText: The shadowed livery of the burnish'd sun

lines.text: To whom I am a neighbour, and near bred.
lines.plainText: To whom I am a neighbour and near bred

lines.text: Bring me the fairest creature northward born,
lines.plainText: Bring me the fairest creature northward born

lines.text: Where Phœbus' fire scarce thaws the icicles,
lines.plainText: Where Phbus' fire scarce thaws the icicles

lines.text: And let us make incision for your love
lines.plainText: And let us make incision for your love

lines.text: To prove whose blood is reddest, his or mine.
lines.plainText: To prove whose blood is reddest his or mine

lines.text: I tell thee, lady, this aspect of mine
lines.plainText: I tell thee lady this aspect of mine

lines.text: Hath fear'd the valiant; by my love I swear
lines.plainText: Hath fear'd the valiant by my love I swear

lines.text: The best-regarded virgins of our clime
lines.plainText: The bestregarded virgins of our clime

lines.text: Have lov'd it too. I would not change this hue,
lines.plainText: Have lov'd it too I would not change this hue

lines.text: Except to steal your thoughts, my gentle queen.
lines.plainText: Except to steal your thoughts my gentle queen

lines.text: In terms of choice I am not solely led
lines.plainText: In terms of choice I am not solely led

lines.text: By nice direction of a maiden's eyes;
lines.plainText: By nice direction of a maiden's eyes

lines.text: Besides, the lott'ry of my destiny
lines.plainText: Besides the lott'ry of my destiny

lines.text: Bars me the right of voluntary choosing.
lines.plainText: Bars me the right of voluntary choosing

lines.text: But if my father had not scanted me
lines.plainText: But if my father had not scanted me

lines.text: And hedg'd me by his wit to yield myself
lines.plainText: And hedg'd me by his wit to yield myself

lines.text: His wife who wins me by that means I told you,
lines.plainText: His wife who wins me by that means I told you

lines.text: Yourself, renowned Prince, then stood as fair
lines.plainText: Yourself renowned Prince then stood as fair

lines.text: As any comer I have look'd on yet
lines.plainText: As any comer I have look'd on yet

lines.text: For my affection.
lines.plainText: For my affection

lines.text: Even for that I thank you.
lines.plainText: Even for that I thank you

lines.text: Therefore I pray you lead me to the caskets
lines.plainText: Therefore I pray you lead me to the caskets

lines.text: To try my fortune. By this scimitar
lines.plainText: To try my fortune By this scimitar

lines.text: That slew the Sophy and a Persian prince,
lines.plainText: That slew the Sophy and a Persian prince

lines.text: That won three fields of Sultan Solyman,
lines.plainText: That won three fields of Sultan Solyman

lines.text: I would o'erstare the sternest eyes that look,
lines.plainText: I would o'erstare the sternest eyes that look

lines.text: Outbrave the heart most daring on the earth,
lines.plainText: Outbrave the heart most daring on the earth

lines.text: Pluck the young sucking cubs from the she-bear,
lines.plainText: Pluck the young sucking cubs from the shebear

lines.text: Yea, mock the lion when he roars for prey,
lines.plainText: Yea mock the lion when he roars for prey

lines.text: To win thee, lady. But, alas the while!
lines.plainText: To win thee lady But alas the while

lines.text: If Hercules and Lichas play at dice
lines.plainText: If Hercules and Lichas play at dice

lines.text: Which is the better man, the greater throw
lines.plainText: Which is the better man the greater throw

lines.text: May turn by fortune from the weaker hand:
lines.plainText: May turn by fortune from the weaker hand

lines.text: So is Alcides beaten by his rage,
lines.plainText: So is Alcides beaten by his rage

lines.text: And so may I, blind Fortune leading me,
lines.plainText: And so may I blind Fortune leading me

lines.text: Miss that which one unworthier may attain,
lines.plainText: Miss that which one unworthier may attain

lines.text: And die with grieving.
lines.plainText: And die with grieving

lines.text: You must take your chance,
lines.plainText: You must take your chance

lines.text: And either not attempt to choose at all,
lines.plainText: And either not attempt to choose at all

lines.text: Or swear before you choose, if you choose wrong
lines.plainText: Or swear before you choose if you choose wrong

lines.text: Never to speak to lady afterward
lines.plainText: Never to speak to lady afterward

lines.text: In way of marriage. Therefore be advis'd.
lines.plainText: In way of marriage Therefore be advis'd

lines.text: Nor will not. Come, bring me unto my chance.
lines.plainText: Nor will not Come bring me unto my chance

lines.text: First, forward to the temple. After dinner
lines.plainText: First forward to the temple After dinner

lines.text: Your hazard shall be made.
lines.plainText: Your hazard shall be made

lines.text: Good fortune then,
lines.plainText: Good fortune then

lines.text: To make me blest or cursed'st among men!
lines.plainText: To make me blest or cursed'st among men
